The King of Dim Sum
Dec 2019 • Family
Crystal Jade hardly needs me to recommend them - as anyone finding it hard to book a table on weekends can confirm!

But credit must be given where due, so here we go

1. Crystal Jade at Lotte Legend has the best Dim Sum in the world. Better than the Michelin-starred places in HK and Singapore.

2: The longstanding Maitre D', Du Du, is the best Maitre D' in the world. Her blend of engaging warmth with her customers and staff combined with the swiss-watch level efficiency needed to keep demanding dim sum customers well fed and happy... hats off!

3: Best fried noodles with XO sauce in the world

4: Best Shanghai dumplings in the world

5: Best shrimp dumplings in the world

6: Great selection of tea 

7: Great service

Now Crystal Jade probably doesnt want to position themselves as dim sum only, so fair enough, if youre going for dinner I'd expect the quality to be the same. I honestly have only gone at lunch. 

One other point - I am referring only to the Crystal Jade at Lotte Legend Hotel. I have no idea how / why, but the Crystal Jade I tried at other locations (ie Saigon Centre) was quite different. Not just quality, but the whole thing: was like they were using a different cookbook.

Dim sum
Apr 2019 • Friends
If you, as I do, regularly have a longing for some proper dim sum, this restaurant will be your new favorite. No, they don’t push steam carts around the room for you to pick your items, but who does that anymore? This dim sum is delicious. Every single item we ordered was spot on. The staff speak English, and Chinese and, obviously, Vietnamese, so there should be no problem ordering. So, so good and I thought the price was reasonable for the quality, great service and cleanliness. We went for dinner once too and it was also very good.
